problems.no-pages: The config needs at least one page
problems.no-columns: A page needs at least one column
problems.too-many-columns: A page can have at most {{max}} columns
problems.invalid-column-size: Column size must be "small" or "full", not {{size}}
problems.full-column-count: A page needs 1 or 2 "full" columns, this one has {{count}}
problems.split-in-head: Head widgets can't be split; put the split-column in a column instead
problems.column-needs-full: A page needs at least one full column, so this one has to stay full.
problems.column-too-many-full: A page can have at most two full columns; make another one small first.
problems.slug-reserved: "{{slug}}" is reserved by Glance; pick another URL path.
problems.slug-taken: Page {{page}} already uses the URL path "{{slug}}"; Glance would only show one of them.
problems.host-is-url: Host is the address Glance listens on, not a URL. Leave it empty to listen everywhere.
problems.host-unclosed-bracket: Host has a [ without a closing ].
problems.host-bad-ipv6: Host has brackets, but no valid IPv6 address inside them.
problems.host-ipv6-needs-brackets: Write an IPv6 address in brackets, e.g. [{{host}}]. Glance adds the port after it.
problems.host-invalid: Host must be an IP address or a host name. Leave it empty to listen everywhere.
problems.port-invalid: Port must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
problems.base-url-invalid: Base URL must start with / (e.g. /glance) or be a full http(s) URL.
problems.listen-in-container: Glance runs in a container. This is the port inside the container. Your Docker port mapping still sends traffic to the old port, so Glance will be unreachable. Change the port mapping instead.
problems.missing-option-in-list: {{widget}} needs a value for “{{option}}” in {{list}}, item {{item}}
problems.glance-validation-off: Glance validation is off — set GLANCE_BIN
problems.glance-reads-file: {{reference}} reads a file where Glance runs; it can't be checked here
problems.assets-unchecked: Glance's assets folder can't be checked here. Set GLAZE_ASSETS_PATH so Glaze can check it.
problems.assets-path-missing: GLAZE_ASSETS_PATH doesn't exist inside Glaze, so Glance's assets folder can't be checked.
problems.glance-unrunnable: GLANCE_BIN can't be run; Glance validation was skipped
problems.glance-timeout: Glance took too long to validate the config
problems.too-many-columns-slim: A slim page can have at most {{max}} columns

editErrors.invalid-path: That place doesn't exist in the config.
editErrors.not-found: That part of the config has changed. Try again.
editErrors.index-out-of-range: That position doesn't exist anymore. Try again.
editErrors.unsupported-structure: This part of the YAML is written in a way the editor can't change. Use the Code view.
editErrors.widget-is-alias: This widget is an alias (*name); edit the anchored widget instead.
editErrors.option-inherited: This value comes from a merge key (<<: *anchor); changing it here would change the anchor. Use the Code view.
editErrors.option-is-alias: This value is an alias (*name); changing it would change the anchored value. Use the Code view.
editErrors.invalid-move: A widget can't be moved there.
editErrors.layout-violation: That would break one of Glance's layout rules.
editErrors.invalid-result: That change would break the YAML.
editErrors.invalid-result-detail: That change would break the YAML: {{detail}}
editErrors.invalid-result-alias: That change would break the YAML: alias *{{alias}} has no matching anchor &{{alias}}

dnd.instructions: To pick up a widget, press Space or Enter. Use the arrow keys to move it, Space or Enter to drop it, and Escape to cancel.

announce.besideBefore: {{list}}, side by side, before the widget at position {{position}}
announce.besideAfter: {{list}}, side by side, after the widget at position {{position}}
announce.droppedOutside: {{name}} was dropped outside a drop area.

api.unreachable: Can't reach the Glaze API. Is the server running?
api.unreachableKept: Can't reach the Glaze API. Your changes are still here.
api.badResponse: The API sent an unexpected response
api.fileConflict: {{name}} changed on disk since it was loaded. Reload Glaze to get the new version.
api.tooManyAttempts_one: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} minute.
api.tooManyAttempts_other: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
api.rate-limited: Too many failed logins. Try again later.
api.bad-request: Glaze sent a request the server doesn't understand. Reload the page and try again.
api.conflict: The file changed on disk since it was loaded
api.io-error: The file couldn't be read or written: {{reason}}
api.not-referenced: The config doesn't use this file
api.outside-config-folder: server.assets-path is outside the config's folder. In Docker, mount Glance's assets folder into Glaze as well and set GLAZE_ASSETS_PATH to it (see the README).
api.too-large: The file is larger than 1 MB
api.too-short: Glance needs a password of at least {{min}} characters
api.too-long: A password can be at most {{max}} bytes (bcrypt ignores the rest)

columnEdge.alreadySmallFull: Column {{left}} is already small and column {{right}} already full.

canvas.noPages: This config has no pages yet.
canvas.includedPage: This page comes from <file>{{file}}</file> and can't be edited here.

codeError.title: YAML has errors — Design shows the last valid version.
codeError.blocked: The YAML in the Code view has errors. Fix them there before editing here.

columnSize.label: Size of {{column}}: {{size}}

columnSize.removeBody_other: Its {{count}} widgets are removed too. Nothing is written to disk until you publish.

head.label: Head widgets
head.empty: drop a widget here to show it above all columns

split.approximateTitle: Glance places these widgets as masonry: each goes in the shortest column. Glaze shows them in reading order, row by row.
split.sharedWidth: All {{count}} widgets in this split-column get this width (Glance draws equal columns).
split.equalColumns: Glance draws equal columns, so the rest of the row stays empty.
split.valueText_one: {{fraction}} of the split-column, {{count}} column, shared by all its widgets
split.valueText_other: {{fraction}} of the split-column, {{count}} columns, shared by all its widgets
split.handleTitle: Drag to resize: ½, ⅓ or ¼ (all widgets in this split-column)
split.dissolved: The split-column had one widget left, so it was turned back into a normal widget.

group.empty: No tabs yet: drop a widget here.

auth.usernameTooShort_one: Glance needs a user name of at least {{count}} character.
auth.usernameTooShort_other: Glance needs a user name of at least {{count}} characters.
auth.usernameInCode: Names with dots or only digits can be added in the Code view.
auth.newKeySet: A new secret key is set. Publishing logs everyone out of Glance.
auth.secretKeyIntro: Signs Glance's login sessions. Glance needs one as soon as there are users; changing it logs everyone out.
auth.keyNeeded: Glance refuses users without a secret key. Generate one below.
auth.keyHint: Or {{env}} to keep it out of glance.yml.
auth.replaceBody: Once you publish, everyone who is logged in to Glance has to log in again.
auth.usersIntro: Glance shows every page to every user; it has no per-page access.
auth.noUsers: No users: anyone who can reach Glance sees the dashboard.
auth.keyGenerated: Glance needs a secret key for users, so one was generated.
auth.plainPassword: The password is stored as plain text; set it again to store a hash instead.
auth.noPassword: No password: Glance refuses this user until it has one.

server.noGlanceUrl: GLANCE_URL isn't set, so Glaze shows no live preview; these options don't affect Glaze.
server.portDiffers: Glaze opens Glance at {{url}}, but Glance would listen on port {{port}}: update GLANCE_URL when you publish this.
server.baseUrlMoves: With a base URL of {{base}}, Glance's pages move under that path; GLANCE_URL ({{url}}) may need it too.

settings.codeError: The YAML in the Code view has errors. Fix them there before changing settings.

server.name: Server
server.text: Where Glance listens inside its own container or machine. To reach Glance on another address or port, change your Docker port mapping or reverse proxy, not these.

auth.name: Login
auth.text: Glance's own login: users and the secret key.

branding.name: Branding
branding.text: Logo, footer, favicon and app name.

document.warning: Scripts here run on every page of your dashboard, for everyone who opens it. Only add code you trust.
document.label: Extra <head> HTML
document.hint: E.g. a <link> to a font, a <meta> tag, or a script such as Glaze's Edit page button.

topBar.authOffTitle: Glaze v{{version}}: GLAZE_AUTH=off, anyone who can reach Glaze can edit the config. Development only.

glanceDown.title: Glance didn't come back after this change
glanceDown.body: A wrong listen address or port can stop Glance from starting, or make it listen where your Docker port mapping doesn't reach.
glanceDown.dropsEdits: Undoing also drops your unpublished edits.
glanceDown.changedSince: glance.yml changed since this publish, so it wasn't undone. Fix it in the Code view.

pages.deleteBody: The page and all its columns and widgets are removed from the config. Nothing is written to disk until you publish.

conflict.title: The file changed on disk
conflict.body: Someone edited <file>glance.yml</file> since you opened it.
conflict.choice: Reload loads their version and throws away your unpublished changes. Overwrite replaces their version with yours.

review.checkFailed: Couldn't check the config: {{message}}. The server checks it again when you publish.
review.yamlBroken: The YAML can't be read, so it can't be published, not even anyway.
review.understand: I understand Glance may become unreachable. Publish this change anyway.

userMenu.logOutBody: Your changes haven't been published yet. If you log out now, they're lost.

resize.title: Drag to resize · double-click to reset

code.label: Code

page.widthHint: Slim pages have at most 2 columns; default and wide pages at most 3.

page.slugHint: Glance uses /{{slug}} when this is empty.

width.inGroup: Widgets in a group are tabs and share the group's width.
width.inHead: Head widgets can't be split; they stay one row above the columns.
width.label: Width
width.shared_one: {{count}} widget in this split-column shares this width: Glance draws equal columns.
width.shared_other: All {{count}} widgets in this split-column share this width: Glance draws equal columns.
width.alone: Alone in its split-column: the rest of the row stays empty until you drop a widget beside it.
width.noWidth: Glance has no width per widget; ½, ⅓ and ¼ put it in a split-column.
width.unwrap: Put these widgets below each other again
width.nested: This split-column sits in another split-column, which sets its outer width.
